dataset_preparation.corpus_scope: All unique title+paragraph pairs from official train and dev; no query-dependent filter
dataset_preparation.relevance_definition: The annotated parent paragraph is relevant; alternative answer-bearing paragraphs are unjudged
dataset_preparation.annotation_scope: Raw parent annotations converted to qrels before timing; never used for routing or calibration

primary_outcome.interpretation: These flags describe measured evidence, not novelty, answer quality or a major-improvement verdict.

query_selection: All queries if query_limit=0; otherwise first query_limit SHA256(dataset + NUL + query_id) values; no labels used
evaluation_status: Engineering follow-up on previously inspected datasets; not a new generalization claim

random_exit_reference.note: Offline quality reference with identical exit count. Assignment variation is not a confidence interval for latency.

extension_protocol.experiment: Indexed-BM25 execution follow-up on inspected datasets
extension_protocol.query_selection: Sort query IDs by SHA256(dataset + NUL + query_id), take first limit. 0 means all queries. Full document corpus retained.
extension_protocol.primary_selection_reason: Existing conservative threshold chosen using inspected NFCorpus/SCIDOCS/TREC-COVID evidence before the indexed follow-up or current full SQuAD outcomes are inspected. Calibration label 99% is distinct from the required 90% floor. Earlier experiments retain their original primary policies.
extension_protocol.change: Precompute the existing BM25 field term contributions into postings. No scorer formula, gate, neural model or threshold changes.
extension_protocol.reproduction_scope: Our MiniLM/SPLADE/RRF adaptation, not exact original-paper Elasticsearch/ELSER reproduction
outcome_rules: Measure optimized static fusion, optimized standalone BM25 and every cascade with the same scorer, plus Dense and SPLADE.
Report actual sampled query count and all available query count. Do not label sampled quality as full-query quality.
No threshold tuning on the sample. Primary frozen r99 is assessed against a 90% floor; keep its original 99% calibration-label verdict too. Report every secondary policy.
Compare prior BM25 top100 IDs and scores after timing; do not serve old rankings as timed inference results.
Report quality, latency, branch counts and uncertainty. No end-to-end speedup is inferred from local BM25 microbenchmarks.
Retain all earlier unfavorable results and standalone baselines. Engineering optimization does not establish new-method priority.

protocol: All four original-feature Ridge gates are frozen from NFCorpus train. No refit or threshold adjustment on evaluation datasets.
Each retriever requests 101 candidates and removes the identical query/document ID before keeping 100, feature extraction, and fusion. This follows BEIR self-match exclusion.
Same indexed BM25 scorer for static, standalone BM25 and every cascade. Frozen original score formula and tie ordering retained.
Sparse postings precompute term contributions; original ridge11 features, rank_bm25 IDFs, Best Fields max and score accumulation order are retained.
Query and method order randomized in each repetition; synchronization before and after every timed query. Warmups excluded.
No cached query results or shared per-query features; fallback neural retrieval executes only on escalation. Corpus indexes may be reused.
All methods scored on identical queries/corpus. Recall/nDCG/MAP metrics use first timed repeat rankings.
Bootstrap resamples queries, pairing recall and repeat-averaged latency; intervals do not capture all hardware/session variability.
Random routing is an offline, count-matched recall reference; its latency was not measured.

Indexed execution follow-up after inspected results. Query sample chosen by fixed hash before its outcomes, full corpus retained. Outcomes and target misses are reported without retuning. RAG answer quality is not measured.
